requests.sourceInterpretation: A worried sad face: upward inner eyebrows, two tiny downcast open eyes with a small tear glint, and a simple small downturned mouth.

submitted.prompt: Create ONE original Daoist Q-style game UI emotion speech-bubble icon as a finished transparent PNG.
